items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Well, he played with him for a while. But Willie Umphrey was mostly on the road.

ctx.x: Did Willie Umphrey play at the Eagle band whenever you heard him or not?
Because he was supposed to play with him for a while. Well, he played with him for a while. But Willie Umphrey was mostly on the road.
